notes.title: v2.0 Now Released!
notes.content:
Hey all!

I would like to gladly announce that the new level is now complete! And today is a big day that marks the official release for v2.0! With all the changes I promised in the prior announcement.

[h2]Albain Promenade Station Released![/h2]
- New level selection prompt before pressing play or hosting a game
- Unlocks once/if you've completed the first level
- Implements the good and my lessons learnt from the first level
- An increase in difficulty compared to Oxford Square Station
- A rewardingly peaceful ending, and a deadly familiar place if you fail
- New achievements to accommodate the new level
- Secrets to find :)

[h3]Voice Chat Overhaul[/h3]
Voice chat has been overhauled to utilise a more robust system (instead of Epic Game's deprecated solution), it should be now more reliable to use proximity chat

[h3]Oxford Square Station Improvements[/h3]
Oxford Square Station is not forgotten either! Improvements and adjustments to Oxford Square Station were made based on gameplay feedback over the months to make the experience more "smooth" (not easier).

[h3]Celebratory Discount[/h3]
Furthermore I have put a 10% discount to celebrate this big day for Anomaly Exit!

Thank you everyone for being a cool bunch, I appreciate all the support, truly.

But now that all of that is out of the way, have fun! 
As usual, make some noise if there's any problems!

ExamlGuy

notes.title: A Sneak Peek into v2.0 & Thank You
notes.content:
Long time no talk!

It's been a minute hey? Sorry for leaving you all in the dark for so long! Many were calling for a new level in the past few months, and I intended to deliver!

However, I was occupied with my real life responsibilities at the time so my progress on the next update was chugging along at a snail's pace.

But now I'm back (no more hiatuses)!

And so, take a peek into what's to come...

[h2]Now arriving at... Albain Promenade Station[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904532/94f53d7530b5bb582e1c2cdc4f2da199c1ebf2a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904532/b63d9ba56842780e2b599116ceb4272313a79328.png[/img]

I intend for this level to take what was good about the first level and make it better, whilst approaching the anomalies in a new way. Ways I didn't get to implement in the first level...

[h3]Additional Planned Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Voice chat system improvement
[*]Anomaly count saving
[*]New achievements with the new level
[/list]
If you have any questions or suggestions, hop on the Discord and have a chat! I would love to hear from you. Join here: https://discord.gg/XUhMM4uN9H

Through my first game, I gave to you my interpretation of the anomaly spotting genre. Through my life, I intend on telling you all the stories from my list of stories I want to tell. All in a fun and interactive way through my games. I just need time.

notes.title: v1.35 Respawn, Anomaly Tracking, and bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the release of another patch! This time primarily involving changes asked from the community!
In this patch, you will find...

[h2]Anomaly Tracking[/h2]

The anomalies that you have correctly spotted will now persist between runs until you have correctly spotted them all! That way you do not need to see the same anomalies again just to have the slight chance of seeing the ones you missed. 

When you have seen them all, the counter will reset and you will be able to see them all again using the same persistence system.

In multiplayer, the host will decide which anomalies are shown, but players joining will still gain progression from what they see from the host match!

[h2]Respawn System[/h2]

With games potentially dragging out for longer now due to last patches introduction of anomaly spotting,  a method to get back into the game in co-op mode has been added. 

On death, the player will need to wait for the rest of the team to guess a certain number of stations correct before they will respawn. Each death will lead to longer respawn time, however. So becareful not to die too many times! You might miss the exit.

[h2]Voice & Player Visibility Fixes[/h2]

I have made a pass over the player handling as it was causing certain players to not be heard and turn invisible at random to certain other players. This one is finnicky however, so it may still occur in different ways.

[h2]Miscellaneous Bug Fixes[/h2]

Additionally, I have added to areas that had gaps in regards to accommodating the new spotting system. As sometimes they would come out as wrong, when they should not have due to weird hitbox calculations.

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]

There is a low chance that restarting the match will not respawn some players due to some unknown specific cases. If this occurs, you should still respawn after the next station. If the players that did respawn are able to make it. 

Let me know if this is an ongoing issue for you.

Thank you to those who voiced their concerns on the areas of the game that needed to be addressed! These changes are a response to you!

As always, reach out on the forums or the Discord if there is an issue! My testing can only get so far for all these new changes.

See you in the next one!
ExamlGuy

notes.title: v1.3 Spotting Anomalies Update
notes.content:
Hello all!

Today, I am dropping the biggest change thus far in Anomaly Exit history! With most of the bugs squashed since my last update, this update is focused on a design oversight in the gameplay loop.

THE NEW FEATURE IS:
- Anomaly Spotting

To keep it short:
- You will now need to mark the anomaly in order to be able to progress to the next station
- If you mark the anomaly incorrectly, you die
- If either you or one of your friend marks the anomaly correctly, you (and your friends) can go to the next station

I have given the station a pass over with the new feature. So it is all accommodated for (as far as my testing could go).

This also means station skipping or guessing is no longer a viable option. On paper it sounded good, but in play it just allowed people to avoid the gameplay loop altogether (and at that point is it even fun anymore).

On the bright side, this also means there is more control over the length of the game. Thus, I have decreased the number of stations needed to be correct before you can win.

Other issues I am investigating:
- Player voice being disembodied randomly

This appears to likely happen when there is huge network lag. So for now, the only way to fix the voice (if it occurs) is to change the host to someone that has a stable connection.

Anyways, now that I've addressed the design issue. I can confidently continue working on the other things I've been hoping to get in.

So stay tuned!
ExamlGuy

notes.title: v1.2 Adjustments + Fixes Update
notes.content:
Hey ya'll!

New day, new update!

- Fixed game not continuing for remaining players when a player last alive in the red zone disconnects, whilst all other players are dead.
- Adjusted several anomalies. Some were triggering too soon, and some were not sensitive enough.
- Adjusted several textures as they were bloating up memory for no visual benefit at all- hopefully this makes it better to run on less VRAM.

Most importantly, I have dialled back the gameplay loop based on feedback and observation on streamed playthroughs (thank you for those who streamed, and made videos!).

The length of a normal game was not in accordance with my intentions that I had for this game. The formula that was responsible for deciding what stations were correct would generate way too bogus of a number more often than not that led to inflated play time.

Furthermore, I have removed some anomalies that were heavy contributors to an inflated play time due to the conditions of their appearance.

I believe I have struck a good balance now. But only time will tell!

Thanks!
ExamlGuy
